name: Olimpbet
verdict: Brand of Russian bookmaker OOO BK Olimp, whose owners are private individuals. Nothing found.
note: Betting brand; official partner of several KHL clubs (CSKA, Severstal, Spartak, Sochi, Amur) and of SKA per the archived club site. Ownership traced to private individuals: OOO BK Olimp is 97.5% held by OOO Zevs, which is owned 50/50 by Darina Denisova and Andrey Petukhov (EGRUL via checko.ru).
